newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Kazakh Uzen oilfield tender result delayed - source.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh Uzen oilfield tender result delayed - source.

text.p: The results of an international tender for Kazakhstan's large Uzen oilfield will be delayed by several weeks, a senior source close to the deal said on Friday.

The source, who asked not to be identified, said three shortlisted candidates -- Amoco Corp, Malaysia' Petronas and Chinese National Petroleum Corp (CNPC) -- had made presentations in the Kazakh capital Almaty this week and improved their original bids, each of over $1 billion.
The result was originally due to have been announced in the last week of October.
Uzen is Kazakhstan's second largest oilfield after Tengiz and has estimated recoverable reserves of up to 150 million tonnes (one billion barrels).
State-owned Uzenmunaigaz holds a licence to the field, which is located about 150 km east of the Caspian Sea in southwest Kazakhstan.
